sections.title: LOWER MS RIVER VALLEY INTO MIDDLE TN/KY
sections.text: BROAD ZONE OF ENHANCED MID/UPPER LEVEL SWLY WINDS WILL PERSIST THROUGH THE PERIOD ACROSS THIS REGION...ALTHOUGH PRIMARY FOCUS FOR DEEP ASCENT /WEAKENING MID LEVEL TROUGH/ WILL CONTINUE TO DAMPEN-OUT IS IT LIFTS ACROSS THE APPALACHIANS. THIS WILL PULL SWLY LLJ NEWD OVER THE TN VALLEY AND INTO THE MOUNTAINS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. MORNING MESO ANALYSES INDICATE PERSISTENT MESO LOW INVOF INFLECTION POINT AS LEADING WIND SHIFT/EFFECTIVE SURFACE COLD FRONT INTERSECTS SW-NE ORIENTED WARM FRONT WHICH WILL TRACK ACROSS NRN MS AND INTO THE TN VALLEY REGION THIS AFTERNOON. STRONGEST STORMS WITHIN ONGOING BROKEN SQUALL LINE MAY PERSIST ALONG AND JUST SOUTH OF THIS LOW CENTER WITHIN AREA OF DEEPEST CONVERGENCE AND MODEST SURFACE PRESSURE FALLS. ALTHOUGH ON THE LARGE SCALE SURFACE WINDS WILL TEND TO VEER THROUGH THE DAY TO A MORE SWLY DIRECTION...SMALL AREA OF BACKED WINDS MAY PERSIST INTO NRN MS/NRN AL/MIDDLE TN ASSOCIATED WITH WEAK SURFACE LOW. SHOULD THIS OCCUR...GIVEN PRONOUNCED LOW-DEEP LEVEL SHEAR...AN IS0LATED TORNADO MAY OCCUR. HOWEVER...PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT WILL CONTINUE TO BE FROM DAMAGING WINDS WITH SMALL SCALE BOW ECHOES/LEWP STRUCTURES WITHIN THE LINE. OVERALL THREAT MAY DIMINISH W

sections.title: CENTRAL FL
sections.text: MODELS REMAINS CONSISTENT IN DEVELOPING ISOLATED AFTERNOON THUNDERSTORM ALONG SEA-BREEZE INTERACTIONS ALONG THE SW COAST INTO CENTRAL FL TODAY...WHERE AIR MASS WILL BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE. DEEP DRY LAYER EVIDENT ON WV IMAGERY AND MORNING SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THAT SHOULD TSTMS DEVELOP...STRONG TO SEVERE MICROBURST POTENTIAL WOULD ACCOMPANY ANY STRONG CORES. ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY WANE QUICKLY AFTER SUNSET. ..EVANS/GARNER.. 10/09/2009

sections.title: UPPER OH VALLEY INTO LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: WIND/TORNADO PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN EXTENDED NEWD INTO WV. FORCED BAND OF LOW-TOPPED TSTMS CONTINUES AHEAD OF SYNOPTIC COLD FRONT THIS AFTERNOON FROM NRN PARTS OF THE CUMBERLAND PLATEAU INTO LOWER MS VALLEY. 3HR SURFACE OBSERVATIONAL TRENDS INDICATE THAT THE GREATEST MOISTURE AND HEAT FLUXES /AND RESULTANT AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION/ ARE OCCURRING OVER ERN KY INTO WRN WV WITHIN EXIT REGION OF 40-50 KT SWLY LLJ WHICH IS DEVELOPING NEWD INTO REGION. FARTHER SW...18Z JAN SOUNDING INDICATES THAT WARM SECTOR AIR MASS HAS BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE OVER THE LOWER MS VALLEY WHERE MLCAPE HAS INCREASED TO 1000-2000 J/KG. CONVECTIVE MODE REMAINS MIXED...FEATURING LINE SEGMENTS WITH EMBEDDED SUPERCELL/BOWING STRUCTURES WITHIN MAIN CONVECTIVE BAND...AND A GRADUAL INCREASE IN MORE DISCRETE STORMS FARTHER E FROM MIDDLE/ERN TN SWD INTO AL. WHILE DAMAGING WINDS WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT...THE POTENTIAL FOR TORNADOES WILL EXIST...NAMELY ALONG LLJ AXIS FROM NRN AL NEWD INTO WV WHERE A MOIST/UNSTABLE AND LOW LCL AIR MASS WILL REMAIN COLOCATED WITH STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR /I.E. 0-1 KM BULK SHEAR OF 30-40 KT/. ..MEAD/COOK.. 10/09/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1111 AM CDT FRI OCT 09 2009/
